task_summary: Geospatial LCOH/LCOA delivered-cost model for African green hydrogen exported to Europe via NH3 shipping + reconversion by 2030; multiple financing/policy scenarios; identify least-cost African sites; quantify de-risking vs interest-rate impacts vs European green H2.
named_methods: GeoH2 / Müller-Kenya levelized-cost approach (component CAPEX/OPEX with CRF)
Schmidt et al. 2019 rising interest-rate impact analysis
primary_outputs: Per-hex delivered LCOH (€/kg H2 to EU) across scenarios
Map of least-cost African sites under baseline + de-risked scenarios
Comparison vs European green H2 reference (low/high IR scenarios)
